parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive message application
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message group to join. Make sure that the specified GroupId exists
parameters.help_zh: 要加入的消息组ID，请确保传入的GroupId是存在的
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID. It is custom-defined and must be unique within the specified AppId. It can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.), and can be up to 32 characters in length. Different users must use different user IDs
parameters.help_zh: 用户UserId，用户自定义，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符。不同的用户需要使用不同的UserId
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The broadcast type of system messages. Valid values:

0: No broadcast. Default value.

1: Broadcast to specified users.

2: Broadcast to groups
parameters.help_zh:
系统消息扩散类型，取值：

0（默认值）：不扩散。

1：扩散到指定人。

2：扩散到群组
parameters.name: broad_cast_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to broadcast statistics messages. When enabled, a broadcast message containing the statistics of the message group is sent after a user joins the group, and the client can accept and process the message. Valid values:

true: Broadcast statistics messages.

false: Do not broadcast statistics messages
parameters.help_zh:
是否扩散统计类消息，打开时在加入消息组后会广播消息组的统计信息，客户端可以接收处理该消息。取值：

true：扩散统计类消息。

false：不扩散统计类消息
parameters.name: broad_cast_statistics

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the user successfully joined the message group. Valid values:

true: The user successfully joined the message group.

false: The user failed to join the message group
Success.description_zh:
加入消息组是否成功，取值：

true：成功。

false：不成功
